subject: [PATCH 2/9] memcg: remove v1 soft limit reclaim

2026-08-13.patch_summary: This patch removes the soft limit reclaim functionality from the Linux kernel's memory cgroup (memcg) v1 implementation. The soft limit tree is always empty, making the reclaim pass a no-op for both direct and kswapd reclaimers. As a result, the code for soft limit reclaim is removed from memcontrol-v1.c and the related declarations are cleaned up in include/linux/memcontrol.h. Additionally, some redundant checks are eliminated in mm/vmscan.c.
